question: Which Ministry is primarily responsible for implementing most rural development schemes in India?

options.text: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Rural Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Ministry of Rural Development** is primarily responsible for implementing various **rural development schemes** in India.
 
• It aims to improve the quality of life in rural areas by focusing on **poverty alleviation, employment generation, infrastructure development, and social security.**
